reviews.classification: partial actual owner read; local capability and causal exceptions qualify opening blanket claims
reviews.disposition:
F1: Actual review covers original1–500 only: TL1–TL7/TS1–TS11/TG1–TG12/TK0–TK5/TN1–TN12/TM1–TM9/TA1–TA6/TW1–TW9/TR/TX1–TX9/TJ/TT1–TT11/TC1–TC8, initial schema/G1–G3, CT1–CT5/CD1–CD12 and candidate proof. Original501–2087 remains. Prior owner folds are not whole-file coverage; this tranche is explicitly partial and does not read linked source bodies.

F2: Preserve distinct person knowledge, actual execution, workshop capability, institutional access, regional use, rough era and cross-world availability. Materials/precision/energy/skill/capital/demand/rights and actual world mechanisms are candidate causes, not a permission checklist. An extraordinary method may bypass a bootstrap chain or supply what it needs under AD38. TS4 adjacent-possible wording is an illustrative path, not a ban on a real leap. A railway can have a real purpose beyond existing town demand. No watcher, guild response, weaponization, fragility, loyalty trouble or forgetting is mandatory merely because technology advances.

F3: TK fidelity is a proposal, not one scalar that automatically grants reliable production, teaching or each failure's XP. A misleading/successful experiment can yield evidence, none or a wrong inference through its actual method. Continuing memory/understanding does not universally degrade on crossing; OD2 and actual carrier decide retention, with skills/body/faculty/records distinct. Mastery, specimen workmanship, structural function, condition, design and rarity remain separate under CT1. Superseded tools may simply be better, without forced balancing weakness; artisans/factories need not rank universally.

F4: TM instrument examples qualify extra measurement channels, not current UI secrecy. AD8 preserves exact own/native counters and actual extraordinary means. Observation can be uncertain or false with provenance, while a stronger faculty may know precisely. A scale/clock/model yields only its real resolution, coverage and freshness; a newspaper/telegraph does not automatically provide live prices. Optional vague presentation does not change known state. Numeric reading is not the entire instrument operation or guaranteed accuracy. Unknown world properties do not prevent an unidentified material actually working.

F5: CT2–CT5/CD rows already qualify early blanket statements: local mechanisms can bypass steps; ordinary tools and cozy/hobby lives are useful; useful advances have real consumers; maintenance/resistance/decay are possibilities. Native clocks and AD16 pause policy decide what continues away. Natural course is not automatic hostile reaction or all-world progress during every absence. Heirs/workshops/institutional rights follow actual custody/people/law, not guaranteed TL3/TL4 inheritance. Cross-world function needs real compatibility/carrier, without a universal magical/electronic incompatibility imported from a franchise sketch.

F6: All early implementation shapes and first-slice rankings remain proposals. Native source observations and named D1 checkpoint are dated, not fresh proof or a reason to extend Frontier against current book-world priority. CT candidate verification is scoped by AD36/AD42/AD43 and current compatibility/desktop owners; no universal human gate or all-old-save test is added. The broad nothing-implemented opening cannot establish current absence of every linked/native supplier. No code, source acquisition, private save, browser/build, migration, worker, deletion, commit or push occurred.
reviews.evidence: Actual original1–500 read in five sequential bounded untruncated outputs. Original2087-line input captured; no full-file or linked-source reading claim.
reviews.reopen: Continue original501–2087 and appended notes; combine actual ranges/input identities before full coverage.
